messages:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we extract a thin core-io abstraction from runtime to decouple protocol adapters (http/grpc/ws) from model execution. Main goals: accelerate frontend experiments, reduce runtime churn, and shrink surface for rollout flags.

mina: This sounds promising. What's your plan for cache ownership and latency risk?

alex: Cache stays owned by session-service for now. core-io will surface prefetch hooks so session can drive warmups. Perf risk: added hop + interface overhead. We expect <3% p99 reg if we inline hot paths and add codegen for small structs.

sam: We need solid contract tests + perf harness before cutting anything. Also how will this affect KV cache metrics and tracing?

alex: Agreed. Plan:
- define stable interface + version header
- implement adapter shim in runtime
- add end-to-end contract tests (mock adapters)
- perf harness + nightly regression job
- canary routing: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> cutover
- rollback path + feature-flag gate

jordan: For rollout, can we dual-write requests so session-service sees both flows? That'd help QA.

alex: Yes. Dual-write + shaded tracing ids. We'll annotate traces with "core_io.v1" header so we can split metrics.

mina: Example interface? Can we see a minimal sketch?

alex: Sure:
```
// core_io.go
type CoreIO interface {
  Dispatch(ctx context.Context, req *Request) (*Response, error)
  Prefetch(ctx context.Context, keys []CacheKey) error
  Close() error
}
```

alex: Local validation command:
```
infra-test --scenario=core-io-migration --perf-harness
```

alex: tldr: small stable shim, canary rollout, contract tests + perf job, dual-write for validation. Open questions: exact metrics to track (p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU queuing, cache miss rate), and whether we add an async path for prefetch to avoid blocking tails.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled to staging at 2024-06-12T03:00Z for core-io-prototype (build #482).

sam: I'll own the perf harness and add the regression alert thresholds.

mina: I'll draft the contract-test matrix and a checklist for QA.

alex: Thanks — I'll spin up a short RFC doc and link PRs. tagging @jordan for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:
